summary: Strengthen invoice, payment and reconciliation controls with practical AP exercises. Review the five-day course outline and see if it fits your team.
lede: Accounts payable management and financial controls help finance professionals oversee invoice approvals, payments and reconciliations with clear evidence. For AP supervisors, finance controllers and analysts, the course develops practical skills in three-way-match exception review, vendor-master change controls, payment-batch checks and AP-to-general-ledger reconciliation. Participants also map controls, test selected procedures and report findings using COSO principles, with introductory attention to digital workflow audit trails.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who process, supervise or independently review accounts payable transactions and controls.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of invoice processing, purchase orders or basic accounts payable procedures is expected. Basic accounting knowledge, including the AP subledger and general ledger relationship, will help you apply the reconciliation exercises. No coding or programming is required.
